vulnerability_title: [M-01] Global Variable Manipulation During Active Draw Alters End Result

recommendation.recommendation_text:
* Restrict all configuration-changing functions (those modifying global variables like the above) to be callable **only when no active draw is in progress**.
* Introduce a locking mechanism that freezes sensitive parameters once a draw is initialized (`initializeJackpot()` called) until settlement completes.

generated_fix.fix_approach: Restrict configuration-changing functions to be callable only when no active draw is in progress, using a locking mechanism.

fixed_code_blocks.fixed_function_code: function setProtocolFeeThreshold(uint256 _protocolFeeThreshold) external onlyOwner { require(!isDrawActive, "Cannot change settings during an active draw"); uint256 oldProtocolFeeThreshold = protocolFeeThreshold; protocolFeeThreshold = _protocolFeeThreshold; emit ProtocolFeeThresholdUpdated(currentDrawingId, oldProtocolFeeThreshold, _protocolFeeThreshold); }
fixed_code_blocks.reasoning: This function now checks if a draw is active before allowing changes to the protocol fee threshold, preventing manipulation during an ongoing game.

fixed_code_blocks.fixed_function_code: function setEntropy(IScaledEntropyProvider _entropy) external onlyOwner { require(!isDrawActive, "Cannot change settings during an active draw"); if (_entropy == IScaledEntropyProvider(address(0))) revert JackpotErrors.ZeroAddress(); IScaledEntropyProvider oldEntropy = entropy; entropy = _entropy; emit EntropyUpdated(currentDrawingId, address(oldEntropy), address(_entropy)); }
fixed_code_blocks.reasoning: This function now includes a check to ensure that the entropy provider cannot be changed while a draw is active, thus securing the randomness source.

fixed_code_blocks.fixed_function_code: function setPayoutCalculator(IPayoutCalculator _payoutCalculator) external onlyOwner { require(!isDrawActive, "Cannot change settings during an active draw"); if (_payoutCalculator == IPayoutCalculator(address(0))) revert JackpotErrors.ZeroAddress(); IPayoutCalculator oldPayoutCalculator = payoutCalculator; payoutCalculator = _payoutCalculator; emit PayoutCalculatorUpdated(currentDrawingId, address(oldPayoutCalculator), address(_payoutCalculator)); }
fixed_code_blocks.reasoning: This function now prevents changes to the payout calculator during an active draw, ensuring that payout calculations remain consistent and fair.

fixed_code_blocks.fixed_function_code: function setReferralFee(uint256 _referralFee) external onlyOwner { require(!isDrawActive, "Cannot change settings during an active draw"); if (_referralFee > PRECISE_UNIT) revert JackpotErrors.InvalidReferralFee(); uint256 oldReferralFee = referralFee; referralFee = _referralFee; emit ReferralFeeUpdated(currentDrawingId, oldReferralFee, _referralFee); }
fixed_code_blocks.reasoning: This function now checks if a draw is active before allowing changes to the referral fee, preventing potential exploitation during gameplay.

Ensured that all changes to critical parameters are locked during an active draw.
